watches.name: Sauté Tiger Iron
watches.description: Introducing Tiger Iron — Behold a physical record of the Great Oxidation Event. Over 2.2 billion years ago, microscopic life began oxygenating Earth’s oceans for the very first time. Out of that ancient planetary shift, Tiger Iron was born. But what makes Tiger Iron different? Over two billion years in the making, this rare natural composite weaves three distinct, raw elements into one striking dial: Red Jasper: Delivers deep, earthy crimson tones. Black Hematite: Provides a metallic, reflective shine and heavy visual weight. Golden Tiger’s Eye: Adds a rich, luminous chatoyancy that shifts with the light. Tiger iron is also renowned for its grounding properties — symbolising strength, vitality, and unyielding confidence. Each dial in this series is completely unique. The 36mm cushion-shaped case houses a traditional jump hour movement, showcasing Morten’s dedication to both functionality and style. LIMITED TO 65 pieces! Limited to 65 individually numbered pieces Warranty 12 Months warranty from date of purchase. Dimensions Case diameter - 36 mm (excl. crown) Case height - 10.7 mm Lug to lug - 44 mm Strap - 20mm/16mm Dial Natural Tiger Iron stone Materials Case - 316L High grade stainless steel Lens - Flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Strap - Natural cow leather. Buckle - 316L Stainless steel pin buckle. Movement ST-1721 Automatic Jump-Hour movement with hour and minute indicators. 20 jewels Water Resistance 5 ATM *Please note that dial pattern may vary as it is made of natural stone.

watches.description: Introducing - Purple Jade. Limited to 65 individually numbered pieces It is with immense pleasure and excitement that we unveil the latest addition to the Zentier Sauté Family— An exquisite new line of watches that exemplifies timeless elegance. We are proud to introduce a limited edition model that captures the essence of sophistication and tradition. Drawing inspiration from his illustrious career as a World Dancesport Champion, Morten Loewe infuses each design with a distinctive sense of elegance. This new collection, aptly named Sauté, refers to a dance term describing a jump or leap, symbolising grace and movement. This exclusive timepiece is limited to just 65 pieces, making it a truly special addition to any collection. We invite you to embrace the elegance and charm of the Sauté— a testament to the artistry of Zentier and the joy of movement. Warranty 12 Months warranty from date of purchase. watches.name: Z5 Ultra Thin - White
watches.description: Introducing the new Z5 ULTRA SLIM Z5 Over the past 3 years I have wanted to do this! I have spent an incredible amount of time, effort and resources trying to envision what the perfect bracelet would look and feel like. More than once I have given up and moved onto different things, but it was always there in the back of my mind bugging me that I couldn’t get it quite right. Finally, after 3 years, here we are! . Creating a bracelet which is not only beautiful, but also comfortable, is in itself a challenge beyond all comprehension. An obsessive amount of attention to detail is demanded, simply to ensure that the bracelet doesn’t pull or pinch the small hairs on the wrist. A simple task right? Not a big deal perhaps? This problem, as trivial as it may sound, would be enough for me personally, to never wear a certain watch despite how much I may like the design of the watch! . Tapering- The tapering of the bracelet is another crucial part when it comes to the comfort of the bracelet. The tapering needs to be done in a way as not to ruin the beautiful lines of the case itself but at the same time it needs to taper enough for the back of the bracelet to be thin and allow the wrist to move freely without actually feeling the bracelet. . Finishing- A soft satin finish, cushioned links plus centre links, bevelling, polishing. The things you immediately notice when you put on this watch. The images, believe it or not, are not renderings or even edited, they are straight of the camera, so; “what you see is what you get”! That is a guarantee! . Another thing which was very important to me personally. The clasp is hidden by cutting out the back of the inside of the bracelet, allowing the clasp to disappear into the bracelet when the watch is closed. This results in a flat profile and needles to say, an extremely comfortable experience. Warranty 12 Months warranty from date of purchase. Dimensions Case diameter - 38mm (excl. crown) Case height - 7.9mm Lug to lug - 46mm Dial Single layer brass dial with stamped guilloche pattern Materials Case - 316L High grade stainless steel Lens - Flat sapphire crystal with 3 layers of anti-reflective coating Caseback - Frosted Sapphire Crystal Bracelet - Integrated 316L Stainless steel bracelet Movement ST-1700 Hand wound, mechanical movement with small seconds sub-dial. 21600bph 17 jewels Water Resistance 5 ATM

watches.name: REVERENCE - Indigo
watches.description: Introducing the new INDIGO - REVERENCE - A sign of honour, respect or deep adoration - felt or shown. The idea which inspired the Reverence collection originated from the very definition of the name itself. To understand, learn and respect the legacy and the classic elements invented by the greatest watch makers of all time. To create something that is timeless and at the same time refreshingly modern. Pursuing and achieving a fine balance between tradition and reinvention. The watch will come with 2 straps as standard (one blue suede and one grey suede). The INDIGO also comes with a brand new travel case which is made in orange epsom leather on the outside and blue suede on the inside. The travel case is designed to provide you with a safe and easy way to store your watch on a daily basis or when travelling. When fully opened the lid of the case acts as a small tray where you can easily change straps or leave your watch over night without worrying about scratches. Warranty 12 Months warranty from date of purchase. watches.name: The Time Traveler - Green
watches.description: Time travelling in style! The Time Traveler is a portable carry case for your watches and can hold up to 3 watches separated and protected by dividers so each watch can be removed separately. We could spend all day explaining to you the outstanding quality and craftsmanship of these beautiful watch cases, in stead we will let you judge for yourself. Years of experience and countless watch box purchases has lead us to know a thing or two about what separates the best from the rest. The watch roll that doesn't roll! The hexagon shape makes for the perfect watch roll! It's shape helps stabilise the case and ensures that it sits flat on the table keeping your watches safe and in place both when the case is open as well as closed. Placement is everything When opening the watch case fully, the cover folds out and acts as a soft padded suede tray for jewellery or as a small work area for you to comfortably change straps on your watches. We have designed this watch case in the true spirit of ZENTIER, as the obsessed watch lovers that we are - that means its made with you in mind! It's thought out and designed in our unique way because we wanted to be able to have the experience of the watches facing forward whenever the case is open - as if on display. The angle of placement of the watches inside the watch case is what gives this case its character and sets it apart from other similar cases.

It's shape helps stabilise the case and ensures that it sits flat on the table keeping your watches safe and in place both when the case is open as well as closed. Placement is everything When opening the watch case fully, the cover folds out and acts as a soft padded suede tray for jewellery or as a small work area for you to comfortably change straps on your watches. We have designed this watch case in the true spirit of ZENTIER, as the obsessed watch lovers that we are - that means its made with you in mind! It's thought out and designed in our unique way because we wanted to be able to have the experience of the watches facing forward whenever the case is open - as if on display. The angle of placement of the watches inside the watch case is what gives this case its character and sets it apart from other similar cases.

watches.name: Zentier Chronograph - 1903
watches.description: Details Introducing the new Zentier Chronograph - " 1903 " Why " 1903 " you may ask! Well, I'm glad you asked. In the year 1900 the famous American billionaire Gordon Bennett Jr. established a car race between Paris and Lyon in France. Each country participating in the race were required to drive a car manufactured in the country for which it would race. Furthermore the car had to be painted in one of the colours from the country's national flag. The nation who won the race would get host the race the following year. In 1902 Britain entered the race for the first time, but with one small problem. The colours of its flag — red, white and blue — were already taken by America, Germany and France, respectively. As a result Britain decided to go with green as the colour of their car, inspired by the English rail road locomotives. A lucky choice it seemed, as Britain ended up winning that year, bringing the Gordon Bennett Cup to Britain for the following year. Unfortunately, 1903 was the year that motor racing was made illegal in Britain and therefore the famous Gordon Bennett Cup had to be relocated to Ireland, who luckily welcomed it with open arms. As a tribute to Ireland, Britain painted its cars to match the colour of the Emerald Isle, also known as Ireland- a deep emerald green colour which later became known as "BRG" or " British Racing Green " But this is where "cars" end and "watches" begin. The enamel dial with its depth, subtle shine and mesmerising green colour makes for a stunning looking dial - almost changing the shade of green under various light conditions. The green colour combined with the applied steel hour markers, white indexes, and the big white seconds hand, creates a beautiful contrast within the dial.
